posts.text:
On this, my birthday…

I thank God for a year, though with more challenges than victories, that taught me lessons hidden in pain, in loss, in struggle.

For showing me that taking a noble stand, even if it costs you, even when you’re criticized, is far better than living safe, silent, and untested.

I Thank God for a year that built grit in so many of us and taught us more about the invincible power of not giving up.

For the humbling truth that no one person can save the world but we all can se

Random acts of kindness.
A shoulder to lean on.
A hand to help someone up.
Strength offered to someone feeling weak.

Today, you may not be able to change the whole world.

But you can make a world of difference to someone.

And sometimes, that is the world begins of bigger changes to come.

Video

Hypocrisy

Video

Trump's unqualified cabinet is costing all Americans

Video

Never forget, this world is filled with heroes.

Villains may dominate the headlines, but they do not define us.

There are far more people choosing kindness, showing courage, offering grace, and doing quiet good every single day.

Don’t let the noise make you forget that.
Don’t let it make you cynical.

And most of all, be one of the people who reminds others of the decency in this world - 

Through your actions.
Through your words.
Through how you show up for others in need.

Video

Keep Fighting.

Video

Trump's policies are a shameful disgrace

Video

The American people are tired of the Trump administration's reckless policies that divide us, endanger our future, and betray our nation.

Video

Everything comes in waves.

Nothing lasts forever.

Storms rise… and storms recede.

So when you feel battered and bruised, remember:

this too shall pass.

Hold fast.

Because tides turn.
Winds shift.

And those fighters, who refuse to let go, who keep rowing through the rough waters,
are the ones who reach open skies,
new horizons,
and waves not of struggle…
but of possibility.

I promise. 

Don't give up. 

A wave of hope is coming.

Video

We don’t have to wait for perfect conditions or guaranteed safety. We were born with wings —the strength, the faith, the courage inside us.

Video

Trump's immigration enforcement continues its cruelty and lack of human decency.

Video

We can choose leaders who lead with truth, humility, and a deep belief in the dignity of every American. Leaders who bring us together instead of tearing us apart.

Video

We cannot ignore the dangers of the Warner Bros.-Paramount merger. It threatens free speech, drives up costs, and limits access to independent news and diverse storytelling. 

Corporate consolidation like this strikes at the heart of our democracy and the creative expression that connects us as a people. 

The merger is far from a done deal, and I will continue to fight it.

Video

The reality of Trump’s budget bill is hitting hard: billions cut from Medicaid, families losing vital health coverage, and hunger growing across the country.

This is not the America we stand for. We deserve better.

Video

The Trump administration continues to show the depth of their corruption, lack of transparency and how they are grifting off of the office.

Video

Do the work.
Choose the attitude.

You may have to go through it - 
but you can glow through it.

Here’s to the people who light it up…
and ignite something in the rest of us too.

These are challenging times - 
but real leaders remind us:

We don't have to shrink in hard times…
we can shine through them.

Video

Never confuse

worth with wealth,
significance with celebrity,
or connection with attention.

Don’t chase “look at me.”
Choose “how are you?”

Video

Congresswoman Jayapal laying it plain.

Video

This is yet another deeply insulting daily moment from Donald Trump.

Leadership isn’t about lifting yourself up by tearing others down.
It’s about lifting others - period.

Leadership shines light. It doesn’t cast shadows.
It leads with integrity.
It does not lead with lies.

Video

Trump’s reckless war in Iran has no justification,no authorization and no exit strategy.
Now Americans are facing skyrocketing costs and oil shocks, while hundreds of our brave service members have been injured and 13 have been tragically killed. 

I won't stop standing up on the Senate floor to stop this war.
